policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 26 Mar close (1x4 3.88, 3x6 4.13, 6x9 4.41, 9x12 4.52 vs WIBOR 3M 3.84) price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC cut by 25bp to 3.75% on 4 Mar (a 'hawkish cut', ING); the projection excludes the war. Glapiński (5 Mar): if things calm within about two months, one more cut is back on the table; no forward guidance. Dąbrowski (26 Mar): the MPC leans to holding rather than hiking; Tyrowicz (24 Mar) sees 4.75% as appropriate. Core CPI fell to 2.5% in February (16 Mar). The fuel package (26-27 Mar) takes ~0.9pp off April CPI (ING, PKO).
policy.risk_text: The market prices NBP hikes while MPC members lean to holding: if oil and inflation expectations keep rising the front end has further to go; the fuel shield and a ceasefire are the relief valves. Long end: global term premia (Bund >3%) and the fiscal cost of the shield.

cpi.m: Feb (GUS, 13 Mar; COICOP 2018, new weights); core 2.5%

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar).
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP (MoF figures in Fitch: 7.0% / 6.5% / 6.2% for 2025-27, debt ~70% of GDP by 2027); 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; the President vetoed the SAFE law (12 Mar); the cabinet plans to take the SAFE loan via BGK for the Armed Forces Support Fund (13 Mar); budget deficit after February PLN 48.5bn (17.8% of the limit); fuel package from 27 Mar (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~41% (25 Mar) financed; MoF cancelled the 11 Mar switch; turned the 18 Mar sale into a switch; cut the 25 Mar offer to PLN 3-8bn; budget accounts ~PLN 171.6bn at end-February. Moody's took no action (20 Mar); S&P reviews on 8 May.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar after holding at 4.00% in January and February; February CPI 2.1% y/y on new weights; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative (affirmed 27 Feb), Moody's A2 negative (no action 20 Mar), S&P A- stable. 26 Mar: the government adopted a fuel package (VAT on fuel cut to 8%, excise to the EU minimum, price caps; ING: about -0.9pp off CPI); Dąbrowski: the MPC leans to holding rather than hiking; BGK sold PLN 0.87bn of FPC (demand 1.06bn); markets price ~50bp of NBP hikes this year; Polish bonds rallied on peace-talk hopes. Abroad: the Bund rose 11bp to 3.07%; the European Parliament approved the EU-US trade deal with conditions.

calendar.plan_text: MoF March plan (27 Feb): sale auctions on 18 and 25 Mar (PLN 7-13bn each; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731 (new 5Y fixed), DS1035, NZ0936 (new 10Y POLSTR floater)) and a switch on 11 Mar buying back OK0426, DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126 and OK0127; no T-bills; WZ sales ended in February. February sales were ~PLN 41bn; ~38% of 2026 needs financed. 9 Mar: MoF cancelled the 11 Mar switch because of market volatility. BGK cancelled its 12 Mar FPC auction (11 Mar). Domański (13 Mar): supply will be adjusted to market conditions. 18 Mar switch: PLN 9.48bn sold (cover 1.45; OK0128 4.257%, new PS0731 4.00% Jul-2031 at 5.011%, new NZ0936) and PLN 9.17bn of 2026-27 paper bought back. 25 Mar sale: PLN 7.29bn vs 8.52bn demand (cover 1.17) plus 0.40bn additional; stop yields OK0128 4.496%, PS0731 5.399%, DS1035 5.725%; ~41% of 2026 needs financed. BGK FPC (26 Mar): PLN 0.87bn sold vs 1.06bn demand plus 0.20bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; in March's sell-off MoF is cutting supply (switch instead of sale, a smaller 25 Mar offer), so remaining dates (the April dates (plan due at month-end)) are less of a supply event. Next MPC 8-9 Apr: a hold is expected while the market prices hikes. The 25 Mar cover of 1.17 was the weakest of 2026.

facts.core_text: Regime: war shock - oil and global yields up, PLN weaker; the NBP cut to 3.75% and turned wait-and-see while FRAs price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the BoE has turned hawkish, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste's CDS/spread table for 26 Mar looked stale or inconsistent, so it is not quoted.) Bund 3.07% (26 Mar).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).

Supply: BGK cancelled the 12 Mar FPC auction and says ~60% of its 2026 FPC financing is already raised (11 Mar); on 26 Mar it sold only PLN 0.87bn (demand 1.06bn) plus 0.20bn - quasi demand is thin in the sell-off.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
